title: Replace legacy Cursor completion path after live upstream rejection
description: Autonomous runtime verification on 2026-09-12: POST /openai/v1/chat/completions with advertised gpt-4o, a synthetic exact-echo prompt, max_tokens=64 and stream=false received HTTP 500. Server logs show the legacy Copilot code-completions endpoint returned HTTP 400, which was flattened to 500. /openai/v1/models still advertises hardcoded gpt-4/gpt-4o/gpt-3.5-turbo. Modernize this path with verified live chat routing, preserve upstream error statuses, and exercise real buffered/streamed tool-capable contracts. Current Claude Code Anthropic route passed eight live synthetic workflows and two real Claude Code CLI workflows; that success does not establish Cursor support.
close_reason: Rebuilt /openai/v1 as a relay to Copilot OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint: live GPT-5.4/GPT-4.1/Claude exact, streaming and tool calls verified; /responses-only models refused with a clear 400; deprecated max_tokens renamed; plain-text upstream errors keep real status.

title: Prevent chat-fallback calibration from overstating context size
description: The original chat-only route returned 14830 (calibrated) for a synthetic 1000-record prompt whose upstream count was 8028, an 84.7% overestimate after mixed text/tool workflows. Native routing now avoids this problem: native provider counts matched direct Copilot native counts for records (8028), code (1685), Unicode (645), and tools (454), and native requests bypass heuristic context clamping. Remaining work applies ONLY to explicit/unavailable-native chat fallback: per-model calibration still mixes tool/schema overhead with text-only contexts and can prematurely clamp/reject requests. Evaluate workload-specific or additive calibration against held-out fixtures; do not claim exact tokenizer accuracy. Final audit 2026-09-12: applies only to ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAM_MODE=chat; native provider counting matched direct Copilot 4/4.
